decisions.reason: The connector inventory and BOOT button are established by separate clauses in the source message and do not change because the exact ESP32-S3 module model is specified.
The GPIO assignments were already resolved for the WROOM-1 module, and selecting the N16R8 memory variant does not entail any further GPIO reassignment.
The USB-C programming-port role is independently stated and already represented by a same-message Event; the exact module model does not require another USB-interface change.
The selected module remains one load on the standalone 3.3V rail, but the N16R8 specification does not change the regulator, activation condition, rail coverage, or source-selection policy.
The 5V boost enable assignment was already updated for WROOM-1 compatibility, and the N16R8 module selection entails no additional change to boost control.
The source confirms that the ESP32 module is on the 3.3V rail but does not alter the rail voltage, current rating, or DCDC1 operating role.
The exact ESP32-S3 memory variant does not change the established I2C pull-ups, series resistors, topology, cable assumptions, or bus speed.
The LED power, level shifting, data GPIO, and standby-control requirements remain unchanged by selecting the N16R8 module variant.
The source preserves sensors on a separate board and does not change the sensor board's connector-fanout role.
The exact controller module model does not change the AXP2101 battery input range, normal power source, or system-load coverage.
Battery electrical protection is located on the power board and is unaffected by the main-board ESP32-S3 module model.
Battery NTC monitoring is a power-board function and remains unchanged by the main-board module selection.
